# MarktMinder

> AI-powered price tracking platform for Amazon, Etsy, and Otto marketplaces.

## About

MarktMinder helps users track prices across major e-commerce platforms and receive alerts when prices drop. The platform supports Amazon.de, Etsy, and Otto.de.

### Key Features

- **Price Tracking**: Monitor product prices in real-time
- **Price Alerts**: Get notified via email when prices drop or reach targets
- **Price History**: View 30-day price charts and identify trends
- **Multi-Retailer**: Track Amazon, Etsy, and Otto products
- **Deal Radar**: AI-powered deal recommendations

## Pages

### Public Pages
- `/` - Homepage with feature overview and pricing
- `/pricing` - Subscription plans (Free, Pro, Business)
- `/login` - User authentication
- `/register` - Create new account
- `/privacy` - Privacy policy
- `/terms` - Terms of service
- `/contact` - Contact form

### Dashboard (Authenticated)
- `/dashboard` - Main dashboard with tracked products overview
- `/dashboard/products` - Manage tracked products
- `/dashboard/products/[id]` - Product detail with price history
- `/dashboard/alerts` - Manage price alerts
- `/dashboard/settings` - Account settings and preferences
- `/dashboard/deals` - AI-powered deal recommendations

## API

The MarktMinder API is documented at `/api/docs` (Swagger/OpenAPI format).

### Key Endpoints
- `POST /api/auth/register` - Create account
- `POST /api/auth/login` - Authenticate user
- `GET /api/products` - List user's tracked products
- `POST /api/products` - Add new product to track
- `GET /api/alerts` - List price alerts
- `POST /api/alerts` - Create price alert

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Products | Alerts |
|------|-------|----------|--------|
| Free | €0/mo | 3 | 3 |
| Pro | €9.99/mo | 50 | Unlimited |
| Business | €29.99/mo | 500 | Unlimited + API |

## Technical Stack

- **Frontend**: Next.js 15, React 19, TailwindCSS
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL
- **Scraper**: Puppeteer, Cheerio

## Contact

- Website: https://marktminder.de
- Email: info@marktminder.de

## Structured Data

MarktMinder provides structured data on all pages using JSON-LD format with Schema.org vocabulary for optimal AI comprehension.
